act.long_title: An Act to provide for protection of the interests of consumers and for the said purpose, to establish authorities for timely and effective administration and settlement of consumers' disputes and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto
act.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

section.heading: Product liability action 84. Liability of product manufacturer
section.html: A product liability action may be brought by a complainant against a product manufacturer or a product service provider or a product seller, as the case may be, for any harm caused to him on account of a defective product.
